description: Graph-native generative belief and transition model. Perceived observations and remembered episodes become provenance-explicit belief states. Simulation requests expand learned, action-conditioned transition hypotheses into bounded branching trajectories containing predicted successor belief states, observations, outcomes, features, confidence, and uncertainty. Expansion is deterministic under graph-held rank, horizon, branch, budget, epoch, and deadline guards. Grounded observations produce prediction errors that revise transition confidence; imagined material is never admitted as observation.

microtheory.name: generative_belief_dynamics
microtheory.description: The agent acts on uncertain beliefs, not direct world state. Transition hypotheses predict successor content conditional on belief and action. Perception corrects those predictions, while remembered and imagined support remain explicitly distinguishable.

rules.name: world_model_supersede_current_belief_on_fresh_perception
rules.comment: A newer perceived sample closes the previous current belief before the replacement is minted. Memory and imagined states are not mistaken for sensory evidence.

rules.name: world_model_reconstruct_remembered_belief
rules.comment: Recall reconstructs a belief with remembered provenance; it does not become the current perceived state.

rules.name: world_model_expand_root_action_branch
rules.comment: One best-supported transition is expanded for each graph-ranked action. The per-branch budget is divided by the maximum branching factor, giving a finite geometric bound even when later states branch again.

rules.name: world_model_expand_successor_branches
rules.comment: Every ready leaf expands across the bounded action repertoire from an immutable predicted-state snapshot. Dividing remaining budget by branching prevents exponential violation of the request budget.

rules.name: world_model_terminalize_leaf_without_applicable_transition
rules.comment: A model dead end is a settled terminal prediction, not a permanently ready leaf. Applicability includes source state, confidence, request action snapshot, and branch rank.

rules.name: world_model_compare_grounded_outcome
rules.comment: Only a perceived observation may score an imagined outcome. The error is graph-held and retains both supports.

rules.name: world_model_revise_transition_confidence
rules.comment: A bounded delta update moves confidence toward one minus normalized absolute prediction error. Epoch marking makes it one-shot at fixed point.
